description: Defines the WebSocketEventInterface class for handling WebSocket network events, including methods for connection lifecycle, data frames, SSL errors, and authentication.

classes.name: WebSocketEventInterface
classes.description: Interface for WebSocket network events, including lifecycle, data, SSL, and authentication handling.

methods.name: OnCreateURLRequest
methods.description: Called when a URLRequest is created for handshaking.

methods.name: OnAddChannelResponse
methods.description: Called when a response is received from the remote server after an AddChannelRequest.

methods.name: OnDataFrame
methods.description: Called when a data frame is received from the remote host.

methods.name: HasPendingDataFrames
methods.description: Returns true if data pipe is full and waiting for the renderer process to read.

methods.name: OnSendDataFrameDone
methods.description: Called once for each call to SendFrame() after the frame has been passed to the OS.

methods.name: OnClosingHandshake
methods.description: Called when the remote server has started the WebSocket closing handshake.

methods.name: OnDropChannel
methods.description: Called when the channel has been dropped due to network or protocol error.

methods.name: OnFailChannel
methods.description: Called when the browser fails the WebSocket channel.

methods.name: OnStartOpeningHandshake
methods.description: Called when the WebSocket opening handshake starts.

methods.name: OnSSLCertificateError
methods.description: Called on SSL certificate error during handshake.

methods.name: OnAuthRequired
methods.description: Called when authentication is required during WebSocket connection.
